query:
UPDATE tagging_services
               SET config = jsonb_set(config, '{rules}', (
                       SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(elem ORDER BY array_position($3::text[], elem->>'id')), '[]'::jsonb)
                       FROM jsonb_array_elements(config->'rules') AS elem
                   )),
                   updated_at = now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc'
               WHERE id = $1 AND owner_id = $2 AND service_type = 'rule'::service_type
                 AND (SELECT array_agg(elem->>'id' ORDER BY elem->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(config->'rules') elem)
                   = (SELECT array_agg(x ORDER BY x) FROM unnest($3::text[]) x)
